<br>

I am an academic researcher of public administration and political science. I am an assistant professor at [at the school of Political Sciences at the University of Haifa](https://poli.hevra.haifa.ac.il/index.php?option=com_sppagebuilder&view=page&id=3&Itemid=539&lang=en). 

My research focuses on the complex relations between bureaucracies, citizens, politicians, and technology and their implications for the functioning of democratic systems and governance, considering contemporary political and societal challenges. I am currently studying the implications of populist government on citizen-government relations.  

I am a methodological pluralist. I also employ in my studies a variety of additional empirical approaches, including experimental designs, observational analyses of administrative data, qualitative case studies, and quantitative and qualitative analyses of interviews.
